posts.author: jshunter
posts.body:
My Protect state has stopped working. It was working happily for months, but now won't kick in for actor or enemy battlers. I've go no notetag modifiers on Protect.
I am using VisuStella plugins. By trial and error removals of them I've narrowed the cause down to something in Battle Core, but I cannot remove it as it is integral to my game. I've got the latest version.
Any general troubleshooting advice, or similar issues with Protect/Substitute?
EDIT:
I have offline backups every two weeks going back to July, but when I try all of them, they also don't work for Protect. The problem must have been going on longer than I thought.
I tried updating RPG Maker MZ to the latest version, 1.9.0. I also went through all my VisuStella plugins and updated them to the latest versions. Nothing worked.
SOLUTION: After exhaustive testing I have identified the cause. The Battle Core plugin has an <Target: Enemy or Ally> notetag which allows you to attack your own party. I applied this to the Attack skill so I could to slap the negative state off an ally. This was causing the problem. If I get rid of the <Target: Enemy or Ally> from the Attack skill the problem goes away. I'll report it to VisuStella.
OUTCOME: VisuStella fixed the Core Engine and Battle Core plugins within hours and Protect now works again.

posts.author: Maliki79
posts.body:
Are you making backups of your project?
If so, do you have a backup where the protect was working?
It's very likely something small you changed and forgot you did.
The backup could probably help you narrow it down.
Maybe a notetag on a state or something like that.
If you don't have a backup, make one, then go to town resetting the Battle core and see if that makes any difference.
You can then restore everything via the backup.
